description: This file defines the ClientEntity class implementing the ClientEntityInterface for OAuth client representation within the OrangeHRM system. It encapsulates client properties such as identifier, name, redirect URI, confidentiality status, and display name, providing methods to access these properties and creating instances from OAuthClient entities.

classes.name: ClientEntity
classes.description: Represents an OAuth client entity with properties such as identifier, name, redirect URI, confidentiality, and display name.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the client.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the client.

methods.name: getRedirectUri
methods.description: Returns the redirect URI associated with the client.

methods.name: isConfidential
methods.description: Indicates whether the client is confidential.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the client.

methods.name: createFromEntity
methods.description: Static method to create a ClientEntity instance from an OAuthClient entity.
